messages:
Talia: Quick design check: I'm experimenting with inline pills for validation + preview status in the Rules list. Prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/inline-pills
Talia: Problem: toasts feel disconnected when you have 20 rules. Pills keep context. Want feedback on tone, placement, and keyboard behavior. @Ravi @Omar @Jess
Ravi: Love pills for context. Suggest using three types: neutral (info), warning, error. Place them to the right of the rule title so they don't shift ordinal alignment. Pills should be focusable (tab) and open a flyout with details when activated.
Omar: UX: make the pill an explicit focus target with a visible keyboard affordance. Keyboard behavior: Tab to pill, Enter to open details, Escape to close. Also provide an inline "Quick fix" link inside the flyout that focuses the inspector.
Jess: Copy nits: for the pill labels prefer verbs: "Add condition", "Check order", "Preview failed" instead of nouny labels. Example: `Preview failed` -> `View failure` or `See why`.
Talia: Good call. Also thinking about collapsed rows — pills should collapse to a tiny dot with aria-label when space is tight. On hover or focus they expand.
Ravi: Accessibility: when a pill opens the flyout, set focus to the first actionable element and use aria-modal="false" so screen reader context remains. Announce via aria-live="polite": "Preview error details opened for rule X".
Omar: Reordering thought: switch from always-draggable rows to explicit "reorder mode" toggle. When on, show handles and expose keyboard reorder via Space->Up/Down. Avoid accidental drags during selection/copy.
Jess: Undo model: inline ephemeral undo per-rule seems neat. Show small "Undo" text next to the pill for 5s after a reorder or pin/unpin action. Also reflect the change in a lightweight timeline in the preview panel.
Talia: Preview spinner problem: rapid sample toggles leave spinner sticky. Engineering note: cancel previous fetch + attach a run id. Debounce 200ms on toggles. I'll add this to the prototype notes.
design-bot: Snapshot: inline-pills-2026-03-23 created by Talia. Contrast scan queued.
design-bot: Contrast scan: 2 pill tokens below AA at 13px (ids: pill-2, pill-7). Suggested pill text color #FFFFFF on dark pill bg or darker tone for light pill.
Ravi: For equal-priority rules, show a tiny tie indicator in the pill flyout: "Tie: manual order applies" plus a small 'Pin' toggle. If pinned, show a padlock next to the rule number.
Omar: Mobile: pills should collapse into the overflow menu to avoid cramped rows. Long press on a row opens actions sheet with Preview, Pin, Reorder, and Details.
Jess: Microcopy for empty-preview: change from "No results" to "Run a preview with a sample request to see matching rules. Tip: try the 'signup' sample." Adds guidance.
Talia: Interaction detail: opening a pill flyout should not close the inspector; instead, the flyout should have a 'Jump to inspector' button that focuses the inspector and announces the field via aria-describedby.
Ravi: Keyboard reorder announcement: when item moves, use aria-live="polite": "Moved rule 'Block anon' to position 2 of 8". Keep messages short to avoid verbosity.
Omar: Small perf idea: animate pill color fade instead of full row reflow when preview results change. Subtle and less jarring.
Jess: Copy for the ephemeral undo: "Action applied  Undo" where Undo is a link. Keep it visible for 5s and then move the action to the timeline with a 'Revert' affordance.
Talia: Action items: 1) Jess to draft pill microcopy and empty-preview suggestion. 2) Ravi to spec a11y focus rules, aria-live strings, and keyboard reorder announcements. 3) Omar to add cancel-run + debounce note and mobile sheet flow. 4) I'll update Figma with collapsible-dot pills and the flyout pattern. Review next week. :thumbsup:
Omar: I'll capture the spinner repro steps and attach logs to the PR.
Ravi: I'll also add examples of aria-label and aria-describedby values in the a11y doc.
Talia: Thanks team!
